questions_hin.q_hi:
In an election between two candidates, the candidate who gets 35% of the votes polled is defeated by 15,900 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?

दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच एक चुनाव में, 35% वोट पाने वाला उम्मीदवार 15,900 वोटों से हार जाता है। कुल कितने वोट पड़े?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let total votes = 100V

Loser's votes = 35% of 100V = 35V

Winner's votes = 65% of 100V = 65V

Difference = 15900

65V - 35V = 15900

30V = 15900

V = 530

100V = 53000

Hence, option 'a' is correct.
